name: Vendor Agreement
description: Fontara's own paper when it buys (buy side, Fontara is the customer): services, fees and term, with the liability, termination and payment positions picked from the buy-side playbook's pre-approved options (Standard or Acceptable), a data processing paragraph only when the supplier handles personal data, and governing law by the buying Fontara entity.

fields.label: Liability Position
fields.help: Buy-side playbook: Standard = sign; Acceptable = procurement and legal operations review.

fields.label: Termination Position
fields.help: Standard: Fontara may terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice. Acceptable: no termination for convenience.

fields.label: Payment Position
fields.help: Standard: net 45, fixed pricing. Acceptable: net 30, renewal increase capped at 3%.

template: This Vendor Agreement is made on {{Effective Date}} between {{Supplier Legal Name}}, {{Supplier Address}} ("Vendor") and {{Legal Entity}} ("Customer").

2. Term. This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an Initial Term of 1 year, expiring on the first anniversary of the Effective Date unless terminated earlier. It renews automatically for successive 1-year periods unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the then-current term.
3. Fees. Customer pays {{Currency}} {{Annual Fee}} a year.

template.text: 4. Fees and payment. The total contract value is the total in the applicable Order Form, with an annualized value of its annual equivalent. Pricing is fixed for the full contract term, and Vendor may not increase it unilaterally. Payment is due net 45 from the invoice date. Vendor may not suspend the services without 30 days' prior written notice. Customer may dispute any invoice in good faith within 60 days of receiving it, and no interest or late charge accrues on a disputed amount. On termination, Vendor shall refund prepaid fees for unused services pro rata, except where this Agreement requires Customer to pay the fees for the rest of the term.

4. Fees and payment. The total contract value is the total in the applicable Order Form, with an annualized value of its annual equivalent. Fees are as set out in the applicable Order Form, invoiced annually in advance. Payment is due net 30 from the invoice date, and overdue amounts accrue interest at 1.5% per month. Fees may increase at renewal by no more than 3% a year over the fees for the prior period. Vendor may suspend services for invoices more than 30 days overdue after written notice.

5. Termination. Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience on 30 days' written notice, without penalty or any obligation for fees for the rest of the term. Either party may terminate for material breach on 30 days' written notice if the breach is not cured within that period.

5. Termination. Neither party may terminate this Agreement for convenience. Either party may terminate for material breach on 30 days' written notice if the breach is not cured within that period. Termination does not affect the rights and obligations accrued before it.

6. Limitation of liability. Vendor's aggregate liability is capped at 2 times the fees paid in the prior 12 months. Neither party is liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages, except as this clause provides. Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations, for data breaches, under indemnification obligations and for IP infringement is excluded from both the cap and that exclusion of damages. Vendor is liable for direct lost profits caused by service outages that exceed the agreed service level thresholds.

6. Limitation of liability. Each party's total aggregate liability is capped at fees paid in the prior 12 months. Neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages including lost profits. Confidentiality breaches, IP infringement, and fraud are excluded from the cap and consequential damages waiver.

template: 7. Indemnity. Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer against all third-party claims arising from Vendor's acts, omissions or breach of this Agreement, including claims that the services infringe a third party's intellectual property rights, and Vendor's liability under this indemnity is uncapped. Customer may participate in the defense of any claim against it with counsel of its choosing, at Vendor's cost.

template.text: 8. Data. Before Vendor processes any personal data on Customer's behalf, the parties shall sign a data processing agreement, which forms part of this Agreement. Vendor shall process that personal data only on Customer's documented instructions and in accordance with the data processing agreement.
8. Data. Vendor does not process personal data on Customer's behalf under this Agreement; if that changes, the parties first sign a data processing agreement.
9. Governing law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
9. Governing law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
9. Governing law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of Ireland.
9. Governing law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, and the courts of Munich have exclusive jurisdiction.
